summary: Static-only source review of the CleanEdit macOS Objective-C++ project after iteration_2 feature additions (activity-bar refactor, explorer New File/New Folder + right-click context menu, mini-terminal shell runner in console, startup extensions, removed gutter border line). Cannot compile on Linux (no macOS SDK) per instructions. Verified brace/paren/bracket balance, @interface/@implementation/@protocol/@end balance, C++ reserved-keyword usage as identifiers, ivar declarations, cross-file #imports, presence of every required new selector, and depth-aware resolution of every [self ...] send against project-declared selectors. Also revalidated Resources/languages/*.json and py_compile'd Resources/scripts/*.py. No compile-blockers found.
critical_code_review_comments: MainWindowController.mm has grown to 1778 lines (was 1599 in iteration_1). Now includes explorer file ops, prompt helper, and mini-terminal NSTask runner in addition to editor host, tabs, find/replace, script UI. Recommend splitting into ExplorerController (new file/folder/rename/delete/reveal/refresh + promptText:info:default:), ConsoleController (buildConsole, runShellCommand:, appendConsole:type:, setConsoleVisible:), FindReplaceController, and TabManager. This is the same 700-line guideline issue as iteration_1 but now more urgent.

runShellCommand: uses `NSTask.launchPath = /bin/bash` + `-lc` which will run user shell profile every keystroke-Return. Fine for a personal tool but a slow login shell will freeze the UI on each command. Consider `/bin/sh` with `-c`, or launching asynchronously (currently NSTask.launch is synchronous-start; output is async but if the user runs a long-running command the terminationHandler leaves stdio handlers on until it ends — no way to cancel from the UI).

runShellCommand:'s readabilityHandler blocks capture partial UTF-8 splits at chunk boundaries — multi-byte characters straddling a read will produce mojibake because `initWithData:encoding:UTF8` returns nil (guarded to @""). Consider a small residual buffer per pipe.

explorerRename:/explorerDelete:/explorerNewFile:/explorerNewFolder: all pass error:nil to NSFileManager. A failing rename/create/trash will silently do nothing; consider surfacing the error via appendConsole:type:@"error".

explorerNewFile: writes an empty file only if it does not already exist, then opens it — good — but if the user typed an existing name, the file is opened without warning (no overwrite confirmation, no notice). Minor UX.

selectSidebarIndex: hides the sidebar container by setting hidden on children only; it also reveals the container if hidden. However, toggleSidebar: hides the whole _sidebarContainer without updating the tinted state of _activityButtons; when reopened via activity click, tints reset correctly, so no functional bug — just cosmetic drift.

Activity bar layout adds `settings` button separately from the vertical topStack (`explorer, scripts, toggleExp, run, console`). _activityButtons stores exactly [explorer, scripts, settings] as required — selectSidebarIndex: iterates by count so index 2 (Settings) is safe. This matches the spec.

ScriptManager.runStartupExtensionsWithHost: appends a `section` console line per extension but never says how many were run / where they came from; a one-time "No extensions installed" hint when the folder is empty would help discovery.

static_review_findings.cpp_reserved_keywords_as_identifiers: NONE. Searched template, typename, namespace, friend, virtual, export, register, explicit, mutable, thread_local, constexpr, decltype, nullptr, static_assert, alignas, alignof, and, or, not, xor, bitand, bitor, compl, and_eq, or_eq, xor_eq, not_eq, class, new, delete, this, operator, private, public, protected. Only benign hits are ObjC message names ([X class], [X new]) and the string literal @"operator" as a token color key.

Verified: (a) new activityButton:tip:tag:action: helper exists and is called 6 times; (b) _activityButtons has exactly 3 entries and selectSidebarIndex: indexes it by .count so it is safe; (c) all new explorer actions and their context-menu items point to defined selectors on self; (d) promptText:info:default: is defined once and called by explorerNewFile:/explorerNewFolder:/explorerRename:; (e) _consoleInput ivar declared, wired to runShellCommand: action, and used inside runShellCommand:; (f) FileTreeController's refresh / clickedOrSelectedURL / selectedDirectoryURL are declared in .h and defined in .mm; (g) ScriptManager.extensionsDirectory (property) and runStartupExtensionsWithHost: are declared+defined and called from MainWindowController.showWindow; (h) LineNumberRulerView.mm no longer draws a gutter border.
